newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae shares hit all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Sonae shares hit all-time high.

text.p: Shares in Portugal's largest industrial group Sonae Investimentos hit an all-time high of 5,000 escudos at the opening of Lisbon bourse, dealers said.
Sonae later pushed higher to 5,006 escudos at 1005 GMT in volume of 31,800 shares.
Operators said Sonae could rise to 5,050 escudos today.
"If a fund enters the market interested in taking a stake in the stock, its price could rise to 5,050 escudos," one dealer said.
The rise of the stock is due to a recently announced restructuring of the company and an improved forecast for the group's extraordinary results in 1996, dealers said.
